Expected results

The PRD rules this test checks, word for word: S3-R11a “Card size is saved per user, separately from Tech View’s density (S6-R3). The choice survives a reload, logout and login, and switching to Tech View and back. A new user starts on Detailed, and if the saved Card size cannot be loaded, Board View uses Detailed.” S6-R3 “Density belongs to Tech View only. Board View’s Card size (S3-R11a) is saved separately.”

  • Step 1: "Detailed" is chosen: a new user starts on Detailed.
  • Step 2: the cards turn Compact.
  • Step 3: after the refresh "Compact" is still chosen and the cards are Compact.
  • Step 4: Tech View is Comfortable; back in Board View "Compact" is still chosen. Changing density did not change Card size.
  • Step 5: after signing out and in, "Compact" is still chosen.
  • Step 6: Tech View is still "Comfortable": Card size and density are saved separately.
  • Step 7: your own Card size is what you noted before the test; {User-C}'s choice did not change it.

The PRD also says Board View uses Detailed if the saved Card size cannot be loaded; that cannot be caused by hand, so write "fallback: not checked by hand" in the result comment.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Work Orders — Board View & Tech View Display Options", Confluence 845185030, version 81 (27 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 28 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10043, stories SV-10046 (Story 3, Board View) and SV-10049 (Story 6, Density); ticket SV-11581 (Card size). Card size added to the PRD in version 79 (27 Oct 2026) after Branko Cicovic, Slavcho Mitrov and Chris Ward agreed it on SV-11581.

  • S3-R11a: “Card size is saved per user, separately from Tech View’s density (S6-R3). The choice survives a reload, logout and login, and switching to Tech View and back. A new user starts on Detailed, and if the saved Card size cannot be loaded, Board View uses Detailed.”
  • S6-R3: “Density belongs to Tech View only. Board View’s Card size (S3-R11a) is saved separately.”
  • S6-R6: “Changing Tech View density never changes which fields, columns, or values are displayed. Board View’s Card size is separate and does hide card content in Compact (S3-R11a).”
